source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 4 (PDF 74-94), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Stoichiometry) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define the mole and Avogadro's number. Explain with examples that one mole of atoms, molecules, formula units and ions contains the same number of particles, and show how the molar mass of CCl₄ is found. (4 marks)
(Mole aur Avogadro's number ki definition likhein. Misalon se wazeh karein ke atoms, molecules, formula units aur ions ke aik mole mein particles barabar hote hain, aur CCl₄ ka molar mass nikal kar dikhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mole: kisi substance ki woh miqdaar jis mein utne elementary entities hon jitne atoms 0.012 kg (12 g) carbon-12 mein hain. Entities atoms, molecules, ions, electrons ya doosre particles ho sakte hain. Alamat n.

Avogadro's number: kisi substance ke aik mole mein entities ki tadaad aik constant hai, 6.02 × 10²³, alamat Nₐ (Italy ke scientist Amedeo Avogadro, 1776-1856, ke naam par).

Misalein:
• 1 mole ¹²C mein 6.02 × 10²³ atoms.
• 1 mole H₂O mein 6.02 × 10²³ molecules.
• 1 mole NaCl mein 6.02 × 10²³ formula units.
• 1 mole Na⁺ mein 6.02 × 10²³ ions.
Chemists mole ko SI unit ke taur par atoms, molecules, formula units ya ions tolne aur ginne ke liye istemal karte hain.

Molar mass: kisi substance ke aik mole ka grams mein mass (unit g/mol). Yeh atoms ke masses ka majmooa hai:
CCl₄ ka molar mass = 12.0 × 1 + 35.5 × 4 = 12.0 + 142.0 = 154.0 g/mol.

book_ref.quote: The number of entities present in one mole of a substance is a constant number named Avogadro

blocks.prompt:
2 Calculate (i) the number of moles in 31.6 g of CaO (molar mass 56.1 g mol⁻¹) and (ii) the mass of 0.150 mol of Na₂CO₃ (molar mass 106 g mol⁻¹). (4 marks)
(Yeh nikalein: (i) 31.6 g CaO (molar mass 56.1 g mol⁻¹) mein moles aur (ii) 0.150 mol Na₂CO₃ (molar mass 106 g mol⁻¹) ka mass.)
blocks.explanation: Mass se moles ke liye n = m/M, aur moles se mass ke liye m = n × M istemal karein.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the mass of 10⁻³ mol of MgSO₄

steps: (ii) m = n × M = 0.150 mol × 106 g mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
3 Explain the relationship between mole, molar mass and Avogadro's number for elements, compounds and ions, with examples. Write the formulas connecting mass, moles and number of particles. (4 marks)
(Elements, compounds aur ions ke liye mole, molar mass aur Avogadro's number ka taluq misalon se wazeh karein. Mass, moles aur particles ko jorne wale formulas likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Elements: har element ka aik mole lene par mukhtalif masses mein atoms barabar hote hain. 12.0 g carbon aur 4.0 g helium dono mein 6.02 × 10²³ atoms.
1.0 g hydrogen = 1 mol H = 6.02 × 10²³ atoms
23.0 g sodium = 1 mol Na = 6.02 × 10²³ atoms
238.0 g uranium = 1 mol U = 6.02 × 10²³ atoms
Sodium ka atom hydrogen se 23 guna bhari hai, is liye barabar atoms ke liye sodium ka mass 23 guna lena hoga.

Compounds: mukhtalif compounds ke aik mole ke mass mukhtalif magar molecules barabar.
18.0 g H₂O = 1 mol = 6.02 × 10²³ molecules; 180.0 g glucose = 1 mol = 6.02 × 10²³ molecules.

Ions: kisi bhi ionic species ke aik mole mein ions Avogadro's number hote hain.
96.1 g SO₄²⁻ = 1 mol = 6.02 × 10²³ ions; 62.0 g NO₃⁻ = 1 mol = 6.02 × 10²³ ions.

Formulas:
Moles = mass / molar mass
Moles = particles ki tadaad / Nₐ
Particles = mass × Nₐ / molar mass

book_ref.quote: A sample of 12.0 grams of natural carbon contains the same number of atoms as 4.0 grams of natural helium

blocks.prompt:
4 A cylinder contains 7.1 g of chlorine gas, Cl₂ (molar mass 71.0 g mol⁻¹). Calculate (i) the moles of Cl₂, (ii) the number of Cl₂ molecules, (iii) the number of chlorine atoms and (iv) its volume at STP. (4 marks)
(Aik cylinder mein 7.1 g chlorine gas, Cl₂ (molar mass 71.0 g mol⁻¹) hai. (i) Cl₂ ke moles, (ii) Cl₂ molecules, (iii) chlorine atoms aur (iv) STP par volume nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Mass → moles (÷ M); moles → molecules (× Nₐ); har Cl₂ mein 2 atoms; moles → volume (× 22.4 dm³).

book_ref.quote: Number of moles of sodium = 2.3/23.0 = 0.1 mol

blocks.final_answer: 0.10 mol; 6.02 × 10²² molecules; 1.204 × 10²³ Cl atoms; STP par 2.24 dm³

blocks.prompt:
5 A bee releases about 1 μg (1 × 10⁻⁶ g) of isopentyl acetate, C₇H₁₄O₂, when it stings. (i) Calculate the molar mass of C₇H₁₄O₂ (C = 12.0, H = 1.0, O = 16.0). (ii) How many moles and how many molecules are released? (4 marks)
(Shehad ki makkhi dank marte waqt taqreeban 1 μg (1 × 10⁻⁶ g) isopentyl acetate, C₇H₁₄O₂, chhorti hai. (i) C₇H₁₄O₂ ka molar mass nikalein (C = 12.0, H = 1.0, O = 16.0). (ii) Kitne moles aur kitne molecules nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Atomic masses jor kar M nikalein, phir n = m/M aur molecules = n × Nₐ.

book_ref.quote: Isopentyl acetate (C₇H₁₄O₂) is the compound responsible for the scent of bananas

blocks.prompt:
6 What is molar volume? State Avogadro's law and explain how 22.4 dm³ of a gas at STP is related to its molar mass, Avogadro's number and one mole, with examples. (4 marks)
(Molar volume kya hai? Avogadro's law bayan karein aur misalon se wazeh karein ke STP par 22.4 dm³ gas ka taluq molar mass, Avogadro's number aur aik mole se kya hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Molar volume: STP par aik mole ideal gas ka volume. Qeemat 22.414 dm³, aam taur par 22.4 dm³; alamat Vₘ. Is se STP par gas ka mass ya moles volume mein, aur ulta, badla ja sakta hai.

Avogadro's law: same temperature aur pressure par tamam ideal gases ke barabar volumes mein molecules barabar hote hain.

Is ka matlab hai STP (273.15 K aur 1 atm) par aik mole ideal gas ka volume 22.414 dm³ hai. Chunke aik mole gas mein Avogadro's number particles hain, har ideal gas ke 22.4 dm³ mein STP par 6.02 × 10²³ molecules hote hain:
STP par 22.4 dm³ gas = gas ka molar mass = 6.02 × 10²³ particles = 1 mole
• 22.4 dm³ CO₂ = 44.0 g = 6.02 × 10²³ molecules = 1 mole
• 22.4 dm³ H₂ = 2 g = 6.02 × 10²³ molecules = 1 mole
• 22.4 dm³ NH₃ = 17 g = 6.02 × 10²³ molecules = 1 mole

Moles se volume: V = n × Vₘ.

book_ref.quote: Since one mole of a gas has Avogadro’s number of particles

blocks.prompt:
7 A gas has a density of 2.86 g dm⁻³ at STP. Calculate (i) its molar mass and (ii) the volume occupied by 16.0 g of this gas at STP. (4 marks)
(Aik gas ki STP par density 2.86 g dm⁻³ hai. (i) Is ka molar mass aur (ii) STP par is gas ke 16.0 g ka volume nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: STP par aik mole 22.4 dm³ gherta hai, is liye molar mass = density × 22.4; phir moles = mass/M aur V = n × 22.4.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the molar mass of a gas which has density of 1.97 g/dm³ at STP

steps: (i) m = d × V = 2.86 g dm⁻³ × 22.4 dm³ mol⁻¹
blocks.final_answer: Molar mass 64.1 g mol⁻¹; 16.0 g STP par 5.59 dm³ gherti hai

blocks.prompt:
8 Define density and molar concentration. Explain why the density of a gas at STP depends on its molar mass, and describe how the number of moles is found from mass, particles, gas volume and molar concentration. (4 marks)
(Density aur molar concentration ki definition likhein. Wazeh karein ke STP par gas ki density us ke molar mass par kyun munhasir hai, aur mass, particles, gas ke volume aur molar concentration se moles kaise nikalte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Density: fi unit volume mass, d = m/V.
STP par sab gases ka molar volume (22.4 dm³) barabar hai, is liye gas ki density us ke molar mass par munhasir hai: zyada molar mass, zyada density, aur ulta. STP par density maloom ho to molar mass = d × 22.4.

Molar concentration: fi dm³ solution mein hal shuda substance (reactant ya product) ke moles, unit mol/dm³:
C = n/V aur n = C × V, jahan V solution ka volume dm³ mein hai.

Moles (concept map):
• mass se: n = mass / molar mass
• particles se: n = particles / Nₐ
• STP par gas ke volume se: n = V / 22.4 dm³
• solution se: n = C × V

book_ref.quote: which is the number of moles of a substance (reactant or product) dissolved per volume of a solution in dm³

blocks.prompt:
9 6.91 g of K₂CO₃ (molar mass 138.2 g mol⁻¹) is dissolved in water to make 250 cm³ of solution. (i) Calculate the molar concentration. (ii) What mass of K₂CO₃ would be needed to make 500 cm³ of a 0.100 mol dm⁻³ solution? (4 marks)
(6.91 g K₂CO₃ (molar mass 138.2 g mol⁻¹) paani mein hal kar ke 250 cm³ solution banaya gaya. (i) Molar concentration nikalein. (ii) 500 cm³ 0.100 mol dm⁻³ solution ke liye kitna K₂CO₃ chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: cm³ ko dm³ mein badlein (÷ 1000), phir C = n/V; (ii) mein n = C × V aur m = n × M.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the molar concentration of a substance containing 27.64 g of K₂CO₃

steps: (ii) n = C × V = 0.100 mol dm⁻³ × 0.500 dm³ = 0.0500 mol

blocks.prompt:
10 What is stoichiometry? Interpret the balanced equation N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) in terms of moles, molecules, volumes and masses, and name the stoichiometric relationships it allows. (4 marks)
(Stoichiometry kya hai? Balanced equation N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) ko moles, molecules, volumes aur masses ke lihaaz se bayan karein, aur is se milne wale stoichiometric taluqaat ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Stoichiometry: chemistry ki woh shaakh jo balanced chemical equation mein reactants aur products ka miqdaari taluq batati hai. Mole, Avogadro's number, molar mass, molar volume aur molar concentration se yeh taluqaat nikale jaate hain.

N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) ko chaar tarah parha ja sakta hai:
• Moles: 1 mole N₂, 3 moles H₂ se react kar ke 2 moles NH₃ banati hai.
• Molecules: N₂ ka 1 molecule, H₂ ke 3 molecules se react kar ke NH₃ ke 2 molecules banata hai.
• Volumes (STP): 22.4 dm³ N₂, 67.2 dm³ H₂ se react kar ke 44.8 dm³ NH₃ banati hai.
• Masses: 28.0 g N₂, 6 g H₂ se react kar ke 34.0 g NH₃ banati hai (28.0 + 6 = 34.0, mass mehfooz).

Taluqaat: mole-mole, mass-mass, volume-volume, mole-mass, mole-volume aur mass-volume.

Mafroozaat: tamam reactants poori tarah products ban jaate hain; conservation of mass aur definite proportions ke qawaneen maane jaate hain; koi side reaction nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: To understand these relationships, we need to interpret information hidden in a balanced chemical equation

blocks.prompt:
11 In the reaction 2Al(s) + Fe₂O₃(s) → Al₂O₃(s) + 2Fe(s), 50.0 g of Fe₂O₃ (159.6 g mol⁻¹) reacts completely. Calculate (i) the mass of Al (27 g mol⁻¹) needed and (ii) the mass of Fe (55.8 g mol⁻¹) formed. (4 marks)
(2Al(s) + Fe₂O₃(s) → Al₂O₃(s) + 2Fe(s) mein 50.0 g Fe₂O₃ (159.6 g mol⁻¹) poori tarah react karti hai. (i) Kitna Al (27 g mol⁻¹) chahiye aur (ii) kitna Fe (55.8 g mol⁻¹) banega?)
blocks.explanation: Mass-mass: Fe₂O₃ ka mass → moles, mole ratio Fe₂O₃ : Al : Fe = 1 : 2 : 2, phir moles → mass.

book_ref.quote: From the balanced equation, 1 mol of Fe₂O₃ reacts with 2 moles of Al

blocks.prompt:
12 30.0 dm³ of N₂ at STP reacts with excess H₂: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g). Calculate (i) the volume of H₂ used, (ii) the volume of NH₃ formed and (iii) the mass of NH₃ formed (17.0 g mol⁻¹). (4 marks)
(STP par 30.0 dm³ N₂ zyada H₂ se react karti hai: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g). (i) Istemal hone wali H₂ ka volume, (ii) banne wali NH₃ ka volume aur (iii) NH₃ ka mass (17.0 g mol⁻¹) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: STP par gases ki volume ratio hi mole ratio hai (1 : 3 : 2); phir NH₃ ke moles = V/22.4 aur mass = n × M.

book_ref.quote: So, the volume of ammonia produced by the reaction of 100 dm³ of H₂ with excess nitrogen is 66.7 dm³

blocks.final_answer: 90.0 dm³ H₂; 60.0 dm³ NH₃; 45.5 g NH₃

blocks.prompt:
13 In a space vehicle, LiOH removes exhaled CO₂: 2LiOH(s) + CO₂(g) → Li₂CO₃(s) + H₂O(l). Calculate the mass of LiOH (23.9 g mol⁻¹) needed to absorb 11.0 g of CO₂ (44.0 g mol⁻¹), and the mass of Li₂CO₃ (73.9 g mol⁻¹) formed. (4 marks)
(Space vehicle mein LiOH saans ki CO₂ khatam karta hai: 2LiOH(s) + CO₂(g) → Li₂CO₃(s) + H₂O(l). 11.0 g CO₂ (44.0 g mol⁻¹) jazb karne ke liye kitna LiOH (23.9 g mol⁻¹) chahiye aur kitna Li₂CO₃ (73.9 g mol⁻¹) banega?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ ka mass → moles; ratio LiOH : CO₂ : Li₂CO₃ = 2 : 1 : 1; moles → mass.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the mass of Li₂CO₃ that can be produced by 20.0 mol of LiOH

blocks.final_answer: 12.0 g LiOH chahiye; 18.5 g Li₂CO₃ banega

blocks.prompt:
14 8.37 g of iron (55.8 g mol⁻¹) reacts with excess sulphuric acid: Fe(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → FeSO₄(aq) + H₂(g). Calculate (i) the moles of H₂SO₄ used, (ii) the volume of H₂ at STP and (iii) the number of H₂ molecules formed. (4 marks)
(8.37 g iron (55.8 g mol⁻¹) zyada sulphuric acid se react karta hai: Fe(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → FeSO₄(aq) + H₂(g). (i) Istemal hone wale H₂SO₄ ke moles, (ii) STP par H₂ ka volume aur (iii) H₂ molecules ki tadaad nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Mass-volume: Fe ke moles; ratio Fe : H₂SO₄ : H₂ = 1 : 1 : 1; phir V = n × 22.4 aur molecules = n × Nₐ.

book_ref.quote: Number of moles of iron (n) = m/M = 7.0 g / 55.8 gmol⁻¹ = 0.125 mol

blocks.prompt:
15 What are limiting and excess reactants? Why is an inexpensive reactant often supplied in excess? Explain with the reaction of hydrogen and oxygen. (4 marks)
(Limiting aur excess reactants kya hain? Sasta reactant aksar zyada kyun diya jata hai? Hydrogen aur oxygen ke reaction se wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bohat se amal mein reactants balanced equation ki nisbat mein nahi hote. Sasta reactant aksar zyada diya jata hai:
• taake mehnga reactant poora matloob product mein badal jaye;
• zyada se zyada product banane ke liye;
• reaction ki raftaar barhane ke liye.
Misaal: zyada oxygen cheezon ko tezi se jalati hai; zaid oxygen bachti hai aur fuel pehle khatam hota hai.

Limiting reactant: woh reactant jo products ki miqdaar control kare aur pehle khatam ho. Is ke khatam hote hi reaction ruk jata hai; zyada se zyada product isi ki miqdaar par munhasir hai.
Excess (non-limiting) reactant: reaction mukammal hone ke baad bacha hua reactant.

Misaal: 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2H₂O(l)
• 2 moles H₂ (4 g) aur 2 moles O₂ (64 g): 2 moles H₂ sirf 1 mole (32 g) O₂ se react karti hai, 2 moles (36 g) paani. H₂ limiting; 1 mole O₂ zaid bachti hai.
• 1 mole H₂ aur 1 mole O₂: 1 mole H₂ ko ½ mole O₂ chahiye, is liye saari H₂ react karti hai aur ½ mole O₂ bach jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The reactant which controls the amounts of products formed in a chemical reaction and is consumed earlier

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the strategy (steps) for identifying the limiting reactant. How does smothering a fire use the idea of an excess reactant? (4 marks)
(Limiting reactant pehchanne ki hikmat-e-amali (qadam) bayan karein. Aag ki smothering excess reactant ke tasawwur ko kaise istemal karti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Limiting reactant pehchanne ke qadam:
1. Diye gaye reactants ki miqdaar se moles nikalein.
2. Balanced chemical equation ki madad se har reactant se product ke moles nikalein.
3. Jo reactant sab se kam product de woh limiting reactant hai; doosra excess reactant hai.
Phir zyada se zyada product limiting reactant se nikalte hain, aur bacha hua excess = liya gaya − istemal hua.

Smothering: aag aik combustion (ihtiraaq) reaction hai jis mein fuel aur oxygen aam taur par buland temperature par mil kar paani aur carbon dioxide banate hain. Shuru ho kar yeh khud jaari rehti hai. Smothering maujood oxygen ko jalne ki zaroori had se kam kar deti hai, yani excess reactant ki miqdaar ghata deti hai, aur aag ruk jati hai. Foams, inert gas aur CO₂ smothering ke liye moassar hain.

book_ref.quote: Identify the reactant which produces the least amount of product as limiting reactant and the other as an excess reactant

blocks.prompt:
17 3.40 g of NH₃ (17.0 g mol⁻¹) is heated with 31.8 g of CuO (79.5 g mol⁻¹): 2NH₃(g) + 3CuO(s) → N₂(g) + 3Cu(s) + 3H₂O(g). (i) Identify the limiting reactant. (ii) Calculate the mass of N₂ (28.0 g mol⁻¹) formed. (iii) Find the mass of excess reactant left. (4 marks)
(3.40 g NH₃ (17.0 g mol⁻¹) ko 31.8 g CuO (79.5 g mol⁻¹) ke saath garam kiya gaya: 2NH₃(g) + 3CuO(s) → N₂(g) + 3Cu(s) + 3H₂O(g). (i) Limiting reactant pehchanein. (ii) N₂ (28.0 g mol⁻¹) ka mass nikalein. (iii) Bache hue excess reactant ka mass nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har reactant ke moles, phir har aik se N₂ ke moles; kam wala faisla karta hai. N₂ ka molar mass lein, NH₃ ka nahi.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the mass of N₂ produced from 1.81 g of NH₃

steps: (i) NH₃ kam N₂ deta hai, is liye NH₃ limiting reactant hai
blocks.final_answer: NH₃ limiting; 2.80 g N₂; 7.95 g CuO bacha

blocks.prompt:
18 0.400 dm³ of 0.100 mol dm⁻³ Pb(NO₃)₂ is mixed with 0.300 dm³ of 0.200 mol dm⁻³ Na₂SO₄: Na₂SO₄(aq) + Pb(NO₃)₂(aq) → PbSO₄(s) + 2NaNO₃(aq). Find the limiting ion, the mass of PbSO₄ (303.3 g mol⁻¹) precipitated and the moles of the ion left in excess. (4 marks)
(0.400 dm³ 0.100 mol dm⁻³ Pb(NO₃)₂ ko 0.300 dm³ 0.200 mol dm⁻³ Na₂SO₄ se milaya gaya: Na₂SO₄(aq) + Pb(NO₃)₂(aq) → PbSO₄(s) + 2NaNO₃(aq). Limiting ion, PbSO₄ (303.3 g mol⁻¹) ka mass aur zaid ion ke bache moles nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har ion ke liye n = C × V; Pb²⁺ + SO₄²⁻ → PbSO₄ 1 : 1 hai, is liye kam miqdaar wala limiting.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the mass of PbSO₄ formed when 1.25 dm³ of 0.05 mol dm⁻³ Pb(NO₃)₂

steps: Ratio 1 : 1, is liye Pb²⁺ (0.0400 mol) limiting; PbSO₄ = 0.0400 mol
blocks.final_answer: Pb²⁺ limiting; 12.1 g PbSO₄; 0.0200 mol SO₄²⁻ bache

blocks.prompt:
19 24.0 g of CH₄ (16.0 g mol⁻¹) is burnt with 80.0 g of O₂ (32.0 g mol⁻¹): CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g). (i) Which is the limiting reactant? (ii) What mass of CO₂ (44.0 g mol⁻¹) forms? (iii) What mass of excess reagent is left unreacted? (4 marks)
(24.0 g CH₄ (16.0 g mol⁻¹) ko 80.0 g O₂ (32.0 g mol⁻¹) mein jalaya gaya: CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g). (i) Limiting reactant kaun sa hai? (ii) Kitni CO₂ (44.0 g mol⁻¹) banegi? (iii) Kitna excess reagent bachega?)
blocks.explanation: Qadam: har reactant ke moles, har aik se CO₂ ke moles, kam wala limiting reactant se, phir bacha excess = liya − istemal hua.

book_ref.quote: How many grams of CO₂ can be produced when 30 g of CH₄ and 50 g of O₂ are allowed to combine

steps: CH₄ se CO₂ = 1.50 mol; O₂ se CO₂ = 1/2 × 2.50 = 1.25 mol
(i) O₂ kam CO₂ deti hai, is liye O₂ limiting reactant hai
(iii) istemal hui CH₄ = 1/2 × 2.50 = 1.25 mol; bachi CH₄ = 1.50 − 1.25 = 0.25 mol = 0.25 × 16.0 = 4.0 g
blocks.final_answer: O₂ limiting; 55.0 g CO₂; 4.0 g CH₄ bachi

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan O₂ ka mass CH₄ se zyada hai phir bhi O₂ limiting hai, kyunke faisla mass se nahi balke moles aur equation ki ratio (1 : 2) se hota hai. Har reactant se product ke moles nikal kar muqabla karein.

blocks.prompt:
20 Define actual yield, theoretical yield and percentage yield. Explain the reasons for which the amount of product obtained in most reactions is less than expected, and state how % yield shows efficiency. (4 marks)
(Actual yield, theoretical yield aur percentage yield ki definitions likhein. Woh wajoohaat bayan karein jin ki wajah se aksar reactions mein product tawaqqo se kam milta hai, aur batayein ke % yield efficiency kaise zahir karti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Actual yield: reaction mein asal mein milne wale product ki miqdaar.
Theoretical yield: balanced chemical equation se nikali gayi product ki miqdaar; diye gaye reactant se zyada se zyada mumkin product.

Actual yield aam taur par kam kyun hoti hai:
1. Filtration, distillation ya separating funnel se alag karna, dhulai, sukhana aur crystallization agar theek na hon to actual yield kam hoti hai.
2. Kuch reactants muqabil side reaction mein hissa le kar matloob product kam kar dete hain.
3. Reaction reversible ho sakta hai, is liye backward reaction product kam kar deta hai.

Percentage yield: reaction ki efficiency actual aur theoretical yield ke muqablay se percentage mein zahir hoti hai:
% yield = (actual yield / theoretical yield) × 100
Jitni zyada % yield, utni zyada reaction ki efficiency (karkardagi), aur ulta.

book_ref.quote: In most chemical reactions the amount of the product obtained is less than the theoretical yield

blocks.prompt:
21 Aspirin is prepared by heating 5.00 g of salicylic acid, C₇H₆O₃ (138.12 g mol⁻¹), with 5.00 g of acetic anhydride, C₄H₆O₃ (102.09 g mol⁻¹): C₇H₆O₃ + C₄H₆O₃ → C₉H₈O₄ + CH₃COOH. (i) Find the limiting reactant. (ii) Calculate the theoretical yield of aspirin (180.16 g mol⁻¹). (iii) Find the % yield if 5.20 g of aspirin is obtained. (4 marks)
(5.00 g salicylic acid, C₇H₆O₃ (138.12 g mol⁻¹), ko 5.00 g acetic anhydride, C₄H₆O₃ (102.09 g mol⁻¹), ke saath garam kar ke aspirin banayi gayi: C₇H₆O₃ + C₄H₆O₃ → C₉H₈O₄ + CH₃COOH. (i) Limiting reactant, (ii) aspirin (180.16 g mol⁻¹) ki theoretical yield aur (iii) 5.20 g aspirin milne par % yield nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Sab ratios 1 : 1 hain, is liye kam moles wala reactant limiting; wahi theoretical yield tay karta hai; phir % yield = actual/theoretical × 100.

book_ref.quote: Calculate the theoretical yield of aspirin, (molar mass 180.16 gmol⁻¹)

blocks.final_answer: Salicylic acid limiting; theoretical yield 6.52 g; 79.7 % yield

blocks.prompt:
23 Explain the importance of stoichiometry in the production and dosage of medicines, and describe its uses in the field of medicine. (4 marks)
(Dawaon ki tayyari aur khurak mein stoichiometry ki ahmiyat bayan karein, aur medicine ke shobe mein is ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tayyari aur khurak: dawa ki khurak banate waqt active ingredient ki munasib (optimum) miqdaar mareez mein matloob asar ke liye zaroori hai. Stoichiometry dawa ki tayyari ki durustagi yaqeeni banati hai; koi bhi farq na-mukammal reaction ya bache reactants / by-products ki milawat ka sabab ban sakta hai. Is se chemists reactions ko theek control kar ke dawa banate hain aur us ki efficiency, asar aur mehfooz istemal yaqeeni banate hain.

Medicine mein istemal:
• Antibiotics: har khurak active ingredient aur nishana bacteria se mutabiqat rakhe.
• Cholesterol: mareezon ke khoon mein cholesterol ki satah maloom karna (cholesterol charbi ki aik qisam hai jo sab buri nahi magar nuqsaan de sakti hai).
• Glucose: diabetes ke mareez ke khoon mein glucose maloom karna; insulin ka istemal blood sugar ke durust control ke liye stoichiometry par munhasir hai.
• Athletes: khiladiyon ke peshaab mein steroids aur doosre stimulants maloom karna.
• Vaccines: moassar nataij ke liye viral antigens ki concentration maloom karna.
• Khurak: mareez ke liye dawa ki miqdaar maloom karna. Dawa kam miqdaar mein be-asar aur zyada miqdaar mein zehreeli halat ya maut ka sabab ban sakti hai; maslan paracetamol (dard aur bukhar ki dawa) ki over-dose aaza aur jigar ko shadeed nuqsaan de sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Stoichiometry allows chemists to precisely control chemical reactions to produce drugs
